env GOEXPERIMENT=jsonv2

muxt generate --output-jsonv2 --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /mixed sse(Mixed(ctx, send, marshalJSON(sendStatus)))" -}}html:{{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.25
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Status struct {
	OK   bool     `json:"ok"`
	Tags []string `json:"tags"`
}

type Server struct{}

// Mixed sends a JSON event whose nil slice renders as [] under
// encoding/json/v2 — the v1 archive (reference_sse_marshal_send.txt) pins
// null for the same shape, proving which library the generated event uses.
func (Server) Mixed(ctx context.Context, send func(string) error, sendStatus func(Status) error) {
	_ = send("frag")
	_ = sendStatus(Status{OK: true})
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/mixed", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	body := rec.Body.String()
	if want := "data: {\"ok\":true,\"tags\":[]}\n\n"; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Fatalf("body = %q, want the jsonv2 JSON event %q", body, want)
	}
}
